workflow: Code and docs in English, conversation in Finnish. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test + pnpm check before every commit; CI on windows-latest runs the same. Commit straight to main while the repo is single-author (public since 17.9.2026); the Atlas model changes go through a PR on the Atlas repo, then wrangler deploy of the MCP worker. A new decision enters the Atlas model first and is rendered into docs/adr/ by node scripts/adr-from-model.mjs. End a session by updating docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/BUILD_INFO.json and, if a lesson was learned, docs/LESSONS.md; put the status to Atlas.
next: A waiting session is not recognised (the owner's finding of 28.9.2026): a session that only waits on a timer (Somnus: a wake-up every few hours) writes nothing for longer than the 10-minute TTL, so its pane's title matches no live session and the diff window does not switch; and it has no edits in the last hour to show. A decision first: (a) match a pane's title against every session's title (the custom-title record, looked up in the transcripts and cached), not only the live ones; (b) with no recent edits, show the session's project's uncommitted changes from git (its working folder's repository); (c) optionally, a 'waiting on a timer' state in the Sessions table - needs its own privacy decision (the wake time is inside a tool call)

The stutter: read ~/.reviewglass/stall.log after the owner's day of use and fix the stage it names. First suspect from the code: every synchronous command runs on the main thread - glass_frame (the frame poll, ~30/s, MBs a frame) shares it with panel_diffs/panel_file_view (fired on every edit, in the drawer and the diff window) and the rider's window-geometry calls; candidates: glass_frame as an async command, the diff commands off the main thread, and buffer reuse on the page.
